summary: System jobs, run on schedules on the control plane, do maintenance such as cleaning old job event data; running them less often or retaining more days degrades database performance, so keep as few days as possible and use external logging for long-term audit data.
questions: How long should I keep job history in automation controller?
Why is my controller database slow?
What do system jobs do in AAP?
Does retaining more job data affect performance?
